name: Remote Control Starfighter Drone Plane
description:
Starfighter RC Plane – Ready-to-Fly, Beginner-Friendly, Crash-Resistant

Take to the skies with the Starfighter RC Plane, designed for beginners and hobbyists who want fun, easy, and safe flying experiences.

Key Features:

Ready-to-Fly (RTF): No complicated setup – just unpack and fly!

Beginner-Friendly Controls: Smooth handling makes it perfect for first-time pilots.

Durable EPP Foam Body: Shock-absorbing design resists crashes and keeps the plane flying longer.

Electric Brushless Motor: Quiet, efficient, and powerful for stable flights.

60-Meter Control Range: Reliable connectivity for mid-range flights.

Optional LED Lights: Fly safely and stay visible in low-light conditions.

Lightweight & Portable: Easy to carry, store, and recharge anywhere.

Technical Specifications:

Material: EPP Foam

Wingspan: 60–80 cm

Motor: Electric Brushless

Flight Time: 8–12 minutes

Charging Time: 60–90 minutes

Battery: Plane battery + 3x AA for remote (not included)

Control Distance: Up to 60 meters

Recommended Age: 14+

Camera: Not included

Why Choose the Starfighter RC Plane?

Unbeatable Value: Affordable pricing with premium build quality.

Made for Beginners: Fly safely and learn quickly.

Crash-Resistant Design: Durable and long-lasting.

LED Light Add-ons: Perfect for evening or night flights.

Available in Bangladesh: Only at kidarkar.com 🇧🇩

What’s in the Box?

1x Starfighter RC Plane

1x Remote Control (batteries not included)

1x USB Charging Cable

1x Rechargeable Plane Battery

4x Spare Propellers

1x User Manual
